text: Do not be glad, O Israel, with rejoicing, like peoples. For you have prostitute yourself against your God; you have made love [for] hire on all the floors of threshing.
The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail in her.
They will not dwell in the land of YHWH, and Ephraim will return to Egypt, and Assyria will eat unclean [things].

They will not pour out wine to YHWH, and their sacrifices they will not be pleasng to Him—like the bread of mourners to them, all those eating it will be defiled. For their bread [is] for their own soul; it will not come [into] the house of YHWH!
What will you⁺ do on the day of the appointed feast, and on the day of the feast of YHWH?
For behold, they go away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up, [and] Memphis will bury them! [And] the preciousness of their silver—the thistles will possess them, thorns in their tents.

The days of punishment have come in; the days of recompense have come in. let Israel knows the prophet [is] a fool, the man of the spirit is insane over the abundance of your iniquity, and the greatness of your hatred.
The prophet, with my God, [is] the one watching Ephraim; a snare of a fowler [is] on all his paths; hostility [is] in the house of his God.
They have sunk deep, corrupting themselves, as in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their iniquity; He will attend to their sins.

Like grapes in the wilderness, I found Israel; as the firstfruits on the fig tree in its first season, I saw your⁺ fathers. They went [to] Baal-peor and dedicated themselves to that shame, and they became as detestable as that which they loved!
Ephraim, like a bird, their glory will fly away from the birth and from the belly and from conceiving.
Even if they bring up their sons, I will bereave them of each man. Yes indeed, woe to them, at My turning away from them!
Ephraim, as I have seen, like Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place; and Ephraim will bring out his children to one who slaughters.
Give to them, O YHWH, what will You give? Give to them a womb miscarrying, and breasts [that are] dry.

All their evil [is] in Gilgal, for there I came to hate them, because of the evil of their deeds, I will drive them out from My house. I will not continue to love them; all their princes [are] rebellious.
Ephraim is stricken, their root has withered; they will not bear fruit. Even if they give birth, I will kill the precious ones of their womb.
My God will reject them, because they did not listen to Him, and they will be wanderers among the nations.
